== Agumon route example ==

Digimon evolution routes vary substantially by game, virtual pet, anime continuity, and training conditions. This file demonstrates how one wiki can document a selected route rather than claiming a universal tree.

<evolution direction="top-to-bottom" theme="minimal">
[node id="agumon" name="Agumon" link="Agumon"]
[node id="greymon" name="Greymon" link="Greymon"]
[node id="metalgreymon" name="MetalGreymon" link="MetalGreymon"]
[node id="wargreymon" name="WarGreymon" link="WarGreymon"]
[node id="skullgreymon" name="SkullGreymon" link="SkullGreymon" form="Alternate route"]

agumon -> greymon [type="level" label="Champion route"]
greymon -> metalgreymon [type="condition" label="Ultimate route" conditions="Use the requirements for the documented game"]
metalgreymon -> wargreymon [type="condition" label="Mega route" conditions="Use the requirements for the documented game"]
greymon -> skullgreymon [type="special" label="Alternate route" conditions="Continuity- or game-specific conditions"]
</evolution>
